verdict.rationale: Namecheap's XML API and Go SDK/Terraform provider expose core domain operations (check, register, renew, lock/unlock, TLD list, DNS record management) that mirror many UI actions [namecheap-docs-18,19,20,21,22,15,17], and dynamic DNS/API endpoints are documented [namecheap-docs-23,1,2]. However there is no evidence that billing, account/security settings, live-chat support actions, or other UI-only workflows are exposed via API, so full UI/API parity is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of account/billing management parity, explicit vendor statement of full API-UI feature parity, independent confirmation that all UI actions map to API calls.
